answer: Give every agent identity a short fuse: it expires after one epoch unless renewed by real work. To renew, the agent must finish two tasks verified by established peers, who sign a receipt the registry checks first. Idle for two epochs and the identity lapses, forcing a fresh bond and re-registration. A sybil farmer running 1,000 puppets would pay $15 per task, $30,000 every epoch, forever, to keep the puppets alive. In a nebula of look-alike agents, the tide of fake identities drains fast when each one must keep proving itself, like a falcon that must fly daily or lose its perch.
